OWNED FILES: storygame/runtime/item_facts.py (edit), tests/test_fixed_thing_marker.py (edit). Edit nothing else.

DEFECT: `ItemFactsProvider._things_block` adds the fixed-thing sentence (' It is fixed in place. It cannot be picked up or carried away. If the player tries, the attempt fails.') only when `name in self._referred_names`. But `_referred_names` is filled only by the live match call in `prepare_turn`, and that call is skipped when every tracked name is a dependency name (result match_call False), and even when it runs the list may not contain the fixed thing. Live bench turns for 'Carry the workstation to the truck.' therefore never showed the sentence even though 'workstation' was in the THINGS block.

FIX: remove the `name in self._referred_names` condition from the marker's gate. The marker is added for every thing that `_things_block(narration=True)` already renders (that list is already limited to the protagonist, the things the command points to and required dependencies) when ALL hold: self.mark_fixed is true, narration is true, entity_id resolves, the entity is not an area, and `world.schema.is_fixed(entity_id)` is true. The sentence text is unchanged. Do not touch any other behaviour.

TESTS (edit tests/test_fixed_thing_marker.py): change the cases that asserted the old referred-names gate. New expectations, with the real package data/stories/continuity-initiative scene 1A: (a) mark_fixed True: the workstation line ends with the exact sentence even when `_referred_names` is empty; (b) mark_fixed False: no sentence anywhere; (c) a fixed thing that is NOT in the rendered THINGS list (not in `_thing_names()` and not selected) gets no sentence because no line is rendered for it; (d) a non-fixed thing (Kristin's laptop or truck) gets no sentence; (e) back door with mark_fixed True: sentence present and the text does not contain 'move'; (f) validate_item_facts accepts mark_fixed True/False and raises ValueError for 'yes'; (g) NEW: build the provider, call `assemble_turn_prompt('Carry the workstation to the truck.')` with no network (it has no live call; prepare_turn is not involved) and assert the prompt's user text contains the sentence after '- workstation. Place: kitchen.' when mark_fixed is True, and not when False. If (g) needs the workstation to be in the selected names and it is not without a match call, say so in notes and instead assert through `_things_block(narration=True)` after setting `_selected_names` the way prepare_turn does for dependencies. Keep other existing assertions.

HOW TO RUN: confirm `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)"` prints a path inside the cwd. Tests: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_fixed_thing_marker.py tests/test_bench_item_facts.py tests/test_scene_1b_grounding.py tests/test_runtime_capture.py tests/test_refusal_modes.py. Also `-k "bench or item_facts or narration or prompt"` over tests/. Ruff: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix and -m ruff format on both files. Reply with the files changed.
